These are data from the unchanged original Python HardwareInfo QA family. They
are not candidate Rust results. The three Python tools are deleted in the current candidate after the complete
predelete native gate passes39709448191. Acceptance still requires actual
postdelete and maintained caller/policy validation.

The positive API capture is the successful hardware-runtime job119537355450 in
[run39691148023](https://github.com/bin9208/openpilot-rust/actions/runs/39691148023)
at d39b1b08c2079e9b3356be06ddddf9db49551be6 (the published PR merge checkout,
whose tree equals f913de3aa). Parent selected source-side request/result/value,
command, datagram and stream members from artifact12388879432 using bounded
HTTP ranges. The selected955 members pass their ZIP CRCs. This does not assert

[Run39702167583](https://github.com/bin9208/openpilot-rust/actions/runs/39702167583)
at3ddae8cbb9a5e7ab9aae1e9d7491aea3ff9af777 independently captures the unchanged
case generator's ordered plans and nine CLI admissions. All12 captured tool/
source hashes agree with both Git commits; every plan's steps and socket bytes
agree with the earlier actual source requests and wire observations. All25 ZIP

binding in the negative CLI admissions is never executed and is not an API

Keep all136 scenarios,3110 calls and70 socket requests. Compressed JSON members
are byte-preserving gzip(mtime0) of the actual source records. The manifest binds
compressed and expanded bodies,30 source dependencies, original Params provider
provenance and original command/status receipts. Native replay must compare
canonical Python value/type/error categories, exact command order/arguments and
request/reply bytes. The sole failed-read partial-order rule for
keyfile-read-errors admits a/b or b/a only with both exact failure diagnostics
and the same successful c fallback last; raw logs remain unchanged. Dynamic Unix abstract peer names retain their original raw
bytes but are validated by the original naming rule on each current invocation.

The earlier positive run did not directly record inherited environment values.
The later plan run records HOME=/home/runner and absent OPENPILOT_PREFIX,
LOG_ROOT and COMMA_CACHE. Native replay uses this explicit environment and must
match the complete retained paths-actual-environment output. Do not describe
these variables as a direct historical environment capture.

The old positive report contains source and native observations; only its source
